name: Amstrad GX4000
significance: A notable European 8-bit console commercial casualty, arriving just as 16-bit systems like the Sega Mega Drive were dominating the continent.

verifiedFactualData.gpuOrVideoChip: Custom ASIC supporting hardware sprites and 32 on-screen colors from 4,096 palette

editorialContent.overview: Amstrad's short-lived console adaptation of its popular CPC+ home computer line for the European market.
